An equivalence relation on $X$ is a relation that is reflexive
($x \mathrel{R} x$), symmetric (if $x \mathrel{R} y$ then $y
\mathrel{R} x$), and transitive (if $x \mathrel{R} y$ and $y
\mathrel{R} z$ then $x \mathrel{R} z$). Such a relation sorts the
elements of $X$ into classes of mutually related elements.
